description: Replace usages of ConcurrentDictionary with FrozenDictionary (System.Collections.Frozen) where the dictionary is populated once at startup/initialization and then only read afterward. The primary candidate is the MimeTypeMap class (src/Abp/MimeTypes/MimeTypeMap.cs) which has large static lookup dictionaries of MIME types to extensions that are populated in a static constructor and never modified. FrozenDictionary provides optimized read performance for these scenarios.
steps: In src/Abp/MimeTypes/MimeTypeMap.cs, the BuildMappings() method returns a Dictionary<string, string> which is wrapped in a Lazy<IDictionary<string,string>>. Once evaluated, it is never modified - only read via TryGetValue. Change the return type of BuildMappings() to FrozenDictionary<string, string> and change MappingDictionary field type accordingly. Call .ToFrozenDictionary() at the end of BuildMappings() instead of returning the regular dictionary directly.
Change the field type from Lazy<IDictionary<string, string>> to Lazy<FrozenDictionary<string, string>> (FrozenDictionary implements IReadOnlyDictionary and has TryGetValue)
Run 'dotnet build Abp.sln' to verify compilation succeeds
acceptance_criteria: Static lookup dictionaries that are populated once and never modified are converted to FrozenDictionary
No mutable ConcurrentDictionary instances are incorrectly converted (those using GetOrAdd must stay as ConcurrentDictionary)
verification: Run 'dotnet build Abp.sln' and confirm zero build errors
